name: Composer
summary: The reply box of a forum, comment thread or discussion: a collapsed bar that is a real Input, opening an editor with a Markdown toolbar, an optional preview pane and Reply / Cancel. Ships a stylesheet that restyles the Discourse composer on the same values.
highlights: Reply box for forums and comment threads
Collapsed bar is a real 40px Input
Toolbar of registry icons, optional preview
Web component, or a stylesheet for Discourse
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-composer>, built only from DS parts. Collapsed it is an <aha-input> (40px, radius 8, the Input contract), never a div painted as a field. Tabbing to it shows the Input's focus ring and changes nothing; a click, Enter, Space or typing opens the editor and moves focus into it, keeping what was typed. Open, it is an editor box with the Input's border, hover and focus ring, holding a toolbar of tertiary icon-only <aha-button>s (sm, 28px, 16px registry glyphs: bold, italic, link, code, bulleted list, numbered list, an upload button when `uploads` is set, and a Preview toggle drawn as a pressed button) above an <aha-counted-textarea> with no cap (4 to 12 rows). The toolbar writes Markdown into the draft; the host renders the preview. With `preview` the pane sits beside the editor from a 720px wide box and below it on narrower ones, in post-body type (16/24 Regular ink). Under the editor sit the primary Reply and the tertiary Cancel. Submit clears the draft and closes; Cancel closes and keeps the draft; both events can be cancelled. Mod+B and Mod+I format, Mod+Enter submits. Discourse renders its own composer (#reply-control), so a theme cannot swap in the element: it loads lib/discourse-composer.css, which restyles the core markup on the same values, and swaps the theme's own collapsed pill for <aha-input> (the Discourse tab).
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS, identical render. React and Vue pass attributes and listen for the composed events. A Discourse theme uses lib/discourse-composer.css on Discourse's own composer markup instead.

spec.label: Collapsed bar
spec.value: <aha-input> at full width: 40px, radius 8, 1px border-default #E3E3E3, placeholder "Join the conversation" in text-placeholder #616161; hover and focus ring are the Input's. Click, Enter, Space or typing opens the editor (typed text carries into the draft); focus alone does not

spec.label: Editor box
spec.value: 1px border-default #E3E3E3 · radius 8 · white · hover border #E70E68 · focus-within #E70E68 border + 2px focus-ring-soft ring, motion-mid ease-in-out (the Input and Textarea focus)

spec.label: Toolbar
spec.value: inside the box, top · padding 4 8 · 2px gap · 1px border-secondary #F1F1F1 under it · tertiary icon-only <aha-button size="sm"> 28 × 28, 16px registry glyph: system-text-b, system-text-italic, system-link, system-code, a 1 × 16 divider, system-list-bullet, system-list-numbers, system-image-square (only with `uploads`) · Preview (system-eye) at the end, pressed while the pane shows

spec.label: Field
spec.value: <aha-counted-textarea maxlength="none" borderless>, 14/21 ink, 12px side padding, grows 4 to 12 rows then scrolls

spec.label: Preview pane
spec.value: post-body type: 16px / 24 Regular 400 text-default #1A1A1A · padding 12 16 · 1px border-secondary #F1F1F1 · radius 8 · up to 360px tall then scrolls · beside the editor (two equal columns) from a 720px wide composer, below it on narrower ones · empty: "Nothing to preview yet" in text-tertiary

spec.label: Actions
spec.value: primary <aha-button> Reply (disabled while the draft is blank) then tertiary Cancel, 8px apart, 12px under the editor; both lg 40

spec.label: Open motion
spec.value: the panel fades in over motion-mid ease-out; prefers-reduced-motion drops it

spec.label: Keys
spec.value: on the bar Enter or Space opens; in the editor Mod+B bold, Mod+I italic, Mod+Enter submit (Mod = Ctrl or ⌘); Escape does nothing, so a draft is never lost by a stray key

props.name: open
props.desc: The editor is open; absent shows the collapsed bar. Set by a click, Enter, Space or typing in the bar; cleared by submit or cancel

props.name: value
props.desc: The draft, in Markdown. Kept while closed, so a cancelled reply comes back on reopening

props.name: placeholder
props.desc: The bar's placeholder and accessible name, and the empty field's hint

props.name: label
props.desc: Accessible name of the editor field

props.name: preview
props.desc: Shows the preview pane; the toolbar's Preview button toggles it

props.name: uploads
props.desc: Shows the image button, which fires `upload`; the host opens its file picker and writes the Markdown image into `value`

props.name: slot="preview"
props.desc: The host's rendered preview: sanitised HTML in a light-DOM child, refreshed on each `input`. Without it the pane shows the draft as plain text, never parsed as HTML

props.name: open (event)
props.desc: Composed; the editor opened from the bar (a host can check sign-in here)

props.name: input
props.desc: Composed, from the field on each change and each toolbar edit

props.name: submit
props.desc: Composed, cancelable; Reply or Mod+Enter with a non-blank draft. Unless prevented, the draft clears and the editor closes

props.name: cancel
props.desc: Composed, cancelable. Unless prevented, the editor closes, keeps the draft and focus returns to the bar

props.name: upload
props.desc: Composed; the image button was pressed

whenToUse.when: replying in a forum topic, a comment thread or a discussion, where the reply box sits collapsed under the posts until someone starts writing
the host renders its own composer markup and cannot swap it for an element (a Discourse theme)
a plain multi-line field in a form, with no toolbar, preview or Reply action
a short single-line entry; never a div drawn to look like one

opinion.note: The collapsed bar is a real <aha-input>, so a screen reader hears a text field named by the placeholder, and opening it lands in the editor, which is the same kind of field; focus alone never opens it, so a keyboard user tabbing past is not pulled into the editor. Never draw the bar as a div with role=button and a 16px radius: it is a field by look and by role. For a signed-out reader, a host opens sign-in on the `open` event, or shows an <aha-button> "Log in to reply" in place of the bar. The element writes Markdown and never renders it: the host's renderer and sanitiser own the preview HTML. The blockquote button is not in the toolbar until the registry has a quote glyph.
